- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Markthalle Neun is a weekly market located in the Kreuzberg district featuring a rotating selection of food stalls selling artisanal cheeses and hand-crafted chocolates.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Street Food Thursday is held every Thursday evening at Markthalle Neun, showcasing the best street food from around the world with a focus on local, seasonal ingredients.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bite Club is a monthly market held at various locations around the city featuring a variety of food trucks, craft beer, and live music.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Street Food auf Achse takes place in several locations over the course of a month, featuring a mix of local and international street food vendors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Thai Park is an impromptu market in the Wilmersdorf district featuring home-cooked Thai food made by Thai residents of Berlin, popular among locals and visitors alike.
